findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: make_study_pack · Private data: make_study_pack, buy_credit_pack, credits_quote · Public sink: credits_quote · Destructive: payment_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: make_study_pack · Private data: make_study_pack, buy_credit_pack, credits_quote · Public sink: credits_quote · Destructive: payment_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
